chosen_assumption: Independently sampled people receive binary treatment t. Hidden u drives uptake and outcome. Instruments z1 and z2 affect treatment only, with no outcome route except treatment. The outcome follows an additive linear model with an unknown intercept and unknown constant treatment effect. No treatment-effect heterogeneity, spillovers or missingness. z1,z2 and c are measured before treatment. Baseline c causes z1, uptake and outcome, so z1 is exogenous only conditional on c; c is independent of z2 and hidden u.
